search_text: published ZDI-25-246 ZDI-CAN-25842 MedDream WEB DICOM Viewer Cleartext Transmission of Credentials Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2025-04-09 CVE-2025-3480 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-3480 5.3 AV:A/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['MedDream'] ['WEB DICOM Viewer'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of MedDream WEB DICOM Viewer. title: MedDream WEB DICOM Viewer Cleartext Transmission of Credentials Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of MedDream WEB DICOM Viewer. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Web Portal. The issue results from the lack of encryption when transmitting credentials. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose transmitted credentials, leading to further compromise.
